.. EssaimDrones documentation master file.

Welcome to EssaimDrones's documentation!
========================================

**EssaimDrones** is a 3D underwater drone swarm simulation built in Python.
It implements biomimetic swarm intelligence algorithms (Boids-inspired separation,
alignment, cohesion) combined with tactical combat modes, hydrodynamic interactions,
and real-time 3D visualization via Matplotlib.

Key features:

* 10 configurable swarm modes (Patrol, Attack, Defend, Schooling, …)
* Realistic hydrodynamic drag and ocean currents
* Safety monitoring with geofencing and collision avoidance
* Performance metrics (cohesion, alignment, safety violations)
* Interactive 3D visualization with real-time mode switching
